description: This file defines the InstallProfileUninstallValidator class, which ensures that an install profile can only be uninstalled if its modules and themes are not exclusively provided by the profile, and if dependencies are satisfied.

classes.name: InstallProfileUninstallValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks whether an install profile can be safely uninstalled by verifying module and theme dependencies and availability.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies and sets up the validator.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the given module can be uninstalled based on profile dependencies and installed modules/themes.

methods.name: getExtensionDiscovery
methods.description: Returns an ExtensionDiscovery object that ignores the install profile during extension scanning.
